# orchestraManifest

The manifest and refusal contract that lets independently developed
crop-analytics components exchange results without knowing anything
about each other beyond this package.

## What it is

A component’s inference result is wrapped once into an
`orchestra_manifest`: what was inferred, which component emitted it, the
method and seed behind it, the load-bearing payload, and the lineage of
any upstream manifest it was derived from. A SHA-256 digest over
version-stable serialised bytes lets any consumer check that the payload
has not been modified since emission, and a consumer declares which
contract versions it accepts so that schema drift fails at the seam
rather than as a wrong number downstream.

Alongside the manifest sit two smaller contracts that travel with it.
The provenance vocabulary propagates a worst-case grounding label, so a
verdict resting on an unverified fact is labelled unverified rather than
asserted with false confidence. The refusal contract lets a gate
recognise any component’s structured refusal or abstention from its
class alone, which closes a silent false negative: more than one
component exports a predicate named `is_refusal()`, each recognises only
its own class, and the bare name resolves to whichever component was
attached last.

## Related packages

- [rdtLite](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rdtLite) collects
  provenance while an R script or console session runs, and writes it as
  a PROV-JSON file.
- [vetr](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=vetr) checks that objects
  match a structural template and writes the error message when they do
  not.
- [pins](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=pins) publishes data sets,
  models and other R objects to boards such as a shared folder or cloud
  storage, so they can be shared across projects.

orchestraManifest works on a single result rather than a script or a
storage location. It records which package produced the result and how,
lets the receiving package check the result has not changed and that it
accepts the contract version, and gives every package one way to
recognise a refusal.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("max578/orchestraManifest")
```

## A worked example

``` r

library(orchestraManifest)

params <- data.frame(a = c(0.12, 0.15), b = c(1.51, 1.44))

m <- orchestra_manifest(
  emitter_package    = "example",
  emitter_version    = "0.1.0",
  inferential_target = "parameters",
  run_id             = "example-001",
  method             = "example:demo",
  seed               = 7L,
  params             = params,
  timestamp          = Sys.time(),
  data_hash          = manifest_data_hash(params, NULL, NULL, NULL, 7L)
)

verify_manifest(m)$ok
#> [1] TRUE

m@params$a[1] <- 0.99
verify_manifest(m)$ok
#> [1] FALSE
```

## Where the contract came from

The contract was a script sourced into a coordination workspace before
it was a package, and manifests minted by that reference carry the bare
class name `orchestra_manifest` while manifests minted here carry the
package-qualified
[`orchestraManifest::orchestra_manifest`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/orchestra_manifest.md).
Both are the same contract, so identity is tested with
[`is_orchestra_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/is_orchestra_manifest.md)
rather than a strict class check, and the package’s test suite includes
a cross-implementation oracle that hashes the same payload under both
implementations and requires the two strings to be identical.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`GROUNDING_GROUNDED`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/GROUNDING_GROUNDED.md)
  : The token marking a fact as grounded
- [`GROUNDING_UNVERIFIED`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/GROUNDING_UNVERIFIED.md)
  : The token marking a fact as unverified
- [`ORCHESTRA_REFUSAL_CLASS`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/ORCHESTRA_REFUSAL_CLASS.md)
  : The shared refusal marker class
- [`as_orchestra_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/as_orchestra_manifest.md)
  : Adapt a component's result into an orchestra manifest
- [`as_orchestra_refusal()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/as_orchestra_refusal.md)
  : Stamp the shared refusal marker onto an object
- [`assert_obs_schema_correspondence()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/assert_obs_schema_correspondence.md)
  : Assert that two manifests describe the same quantities the same way
- [`combine_grounding()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/combine_grounding.md)
  : Combine grounding tokens worst-case
- [`consume_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/consume_manifest.md)
  : Consume a manifest, or refuse it loudly
- [`grounding_token()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/grounding_token.md)
  : Mint a grounding token for a set of facts
- [`inferential_targets()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/inferential_targets.md)
  : The permitted inferential targets
- [`is_orchestra_decline()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/is_orchestra_decline.md)
  : Did any orchestra component decline to stand behind a result?
- [`is_orchestra_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/is_orchestra_manifest.md)
  : Is this object an orchestra manifest?
- [`is_orchestra_refusal()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/is_orchestra_refusal.md)
  : Is this a refusal from any orchestra component?
- [`manifest_data_hash()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/manifest_data_hash.md)
  : Hash a manifest's load-bearing payload
- [`manifest_from_gmm()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/manifest_from_gmm.md)
  : Adapt a proxymix mixture fit
- [`manifest_from_pesto()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/manifest_from_pesto.md)
  : Adapt a PESTO ensemble manifest
- [`manifest_lineage()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/manifest_lineage.md)
  : Take a provenance handle from an upstream manifest
- [`manifest_summary()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/manifest_summary.md)
  : A manifest's headline verdict
- [`manifest_version()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/manifest_version.md)
  : The contract version this package emits and accepts
- [`orchestra_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/orchestra_manifest.md)
  : The orchestra manifest
- [`verify_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/orchestraManifest/reference/verify_manifest.md)
  : Verify a manifest's payload against its stored hash
